response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong fundamentals, testing discipline, and CI/CD exposure, but the profile is a poor match for this role's mandatory requirements. His C++ work is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago (2014-2015) plus a university thesis project; there is no evidence of 5-10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. His career centers on web/backend work in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, primarily on Linux. SQL Server/Oracle experience is not demonstrated (SQL and MySQL/MongoDB only), and there is no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience — the RIDE Capital role was an investment fintech but built on Node/GraphQL, which is only tangential. Interviewing would likely require the client to waive two of three mandatory criteria.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience (15+ years) with strong TDD, CI/CD, and craftsmanship practices
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of req/sec at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Excellent communication evidenced by conference talks, workshops, and courses he authored
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and ~11 years stale; no Windows-platform C++ depth
No SQL Server or Oracle experience; database background is MongoDB/MySQL
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital-markets/investment-banking domain exposure
